info.name: Computer use harness
info.description: Local only. Start the app with COMPUTER_USE_FIXTURE=1. The route returns 404 when that flag is off and 403 when Host is not loopback. It does not accept a vector store id and it does not read the team library. No API key is sent.

request.description: Returns the cited passage for the fixture question. The answer text does not repeat the code; the citation text does, when the right passage is selected.
